title: Oak

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Oak is a type of tree that can be found in the Meadows. It is characterized by its wide trunk and large crown. A Bronze axe or better is required to damage it. They are most likely found in the open fields of the Meadows.
Oak trees produce Wood and Finewood when destroyed. The yield of each type of wood appears to be random, however, a tree will always drop 50 pieces of wood total.
It is possible to damage Oak trees by intentionally hitting them with falling Beech trees, or rolling fallen Beech trees into it. If enough damage is done by falling trees, the Oak tree will be brought down. The trunk can then be rolled downslope (ideally) and repeatedly smashed into obstacles until it shatters into usable lumber. Oak trees can also be destroyed by a Troll. These methods allow players to acquire Finewood before being able to craft a Bronze axe.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Because they will always drop a total of 50 wood, as well as dropping both Finewood and Wood, Oak trees are one of the best sources of wood in the game and should not be overlooked.
